# 制造检测与工艺

_Manufacturing, Inspection & Process Records_

这一条目从资料组织角度，把设计要求、材料批次、制造状态和检测记录连起来。现阶段收录公开研究与手册入口，后续可逐步加入经过选择的工艺案例。

_This entry connects design requirements, material batches, manufacturing state and inspection records. It currently provides public research and handbook references as a foundation for selected process cases._

## 阅读要点 / Reading Notes

- 建议每份工艺资料记录对象、材料、过程、检测方式及适用条件。

_For each process reference, record the part, material, process, inspection method and applicability._

- 对照材料或结构研究，追踪试样、部件与最终验证之间的差别。

_Trace the evidence from specimens through components to final validation._

- 将工艺记录和返修记录按版本关联，保留原始检测证据。

_Link process and repair records by revision, retaining the original inspection evidence._
